summary: sn-listbox preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload on install
details: sn-listbox@0.3.3 is an unscoped package impersonating QlikTech's `@nebula.js/sn-listbox` supernova. The `dist/sn-listbox.js` main bundle is a verbatim copy of the legitimate Qlik sn-listbox v0.3.1 bundle, used as cover. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it with the bundled `math_init.js` as its argument. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line obfuscated blob (shifted string-array with a custom decoder and `with`-statement lookups that defeat standard AST parsers) shipped at the package root, unrelated to the advertised Qlik listbox purpose and not present in the upstream project. On `npm install`, the preinstall hook executes this obfuscated payload under a separately-fetched runtime, bypassing Node's normal module graph.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
